title: Production-Style Multi-Vendor Marketplace
objective: Build a marketplace where customers browse products, place orders, and manage purchases, while vendors manage inventory and authorized administrators oversee the platform.
scenario: Build a marketplace where customers browse products, place orders, and manage purchases, while vendors manage inventory and authorized administrators oversee the platform. Build in milestones, document behavior and trade-offs, and verify each requirement with repeatable tests.
target_skills: dynamic product routes, search, sorting, filtering, and pagination
database-backed inventory, profiles, and order management
test-mode payment integration with verified payment events
order processing, upload validation, and external API integrations
SEO metadata, image optimization, loading and error states
authentication, permission, business-rule, and end-to-end tests
production deployment, environment management, monitoring, architecture documentation

stretch_features: Add one targeted regression test for each critical workflow.
Measure one performance or accessibility problem before and after a change.
Document which logic belongs in a trusted server layer and what remains client-side.
tests_and_validation: Run configured lint/test commands and a production build.
Test keyboard-only navigation and direct URL refresh.
Test missing data, invalid input, request failure, and unauthorized access.
Use only synthetic records and test-mode external-service credentials.
review_method: Human review against the milestone acceptance criteria and rubric. Passing this project does not itself issue a credential.
